messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran into a CI flake because the eval-harness CLI returns exit code 0 even when config parsing fails. Repro below.

maria: ```
$ ./bin/eval-harness run configs/bad.yaml
Parsing config: configs/bad.yaml
WARN: unknown field 'quant_mode' in eval section
Loaded 3 tasks
Running...
Completed 0/3 tasks (skipped 3)
All done.
Exit code: 0
```

maria: CI treats that as success so it doesn't fail the pipeline when the config was invalid. :facepalm:

ash: Oof. That's definitely bad. The CLI should non-zero on parse errors or if zero tasks run. What CLI lib are we using? click/argparse?

maria: It's our thin wrapper around click. We currently catch exceptions and print them but always sys.exit(0) in main() for a graceful UX — which is the culprit.

kevin: Classic. We should map errors to conventional codes: 0=ok, 2=config/usage error, 3=runtime/infrastructure error, 4=eval failure (e.g. regressions when --fail-on-regression).

kevin: Quick suggestion: raise SystemExit(2) for ConfigError, SystemExit(3) for RuntimeError, and let the harness set 4 when --fail-on-regression finds a regression.

jen: @kevin +1. Also add a `--exit-on-zero-tasks` flag (default true?) so local devs can keep the relaxed behavior but CI can enforce strictness. Document in README too.

maria: I like `--strict-exit` (bool) and `--fail-on-zero-tasks` for explicitness. Default: strict-exit=false for local, but CI should pass `--strict-exit` in pipeline job.

ash: Can we also change `--help` to show the exit codes summary? Small doc improvement but super helpful for infra. Example:
```
Exit codes:
  0  success
  2  config/usage error
  3  infra/runtime error
  4  evaluation reports regressions (only if --fail-on-regression)
```

maria: I'll open a tiny PR: validate config early, raise ConfigError on unknown fields, wire exit codes, and add a README snippet.

kevin: Nice. Add unit tests around subprocess exit codes and a CI job that runs `eval-harness run` against a known-bad config expecting non-zero. That should catch regressions.

jen: Also add an integration test for `--help` content so we don't regress the help text. It's small but saved us before.

maria: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/infr/eval-harness/pull/482 — includes code + tests + docs. pinging reviewers @ash @kevin.

ci-bot: workflow: eval-harness/unit-tests — queued

ci-bot: workflow: eval-harness/unit-tests — success ✅

ash: Reviewed and left a couple inline comments about logging vs printing. Will approve after that.

kevin: Approved. One nit about the exit code constants in `cli/exit_codes.py` but fine to follow up.

maria: Merged. Thanks everyone. I'll update the dev/ci templates to include `--strict-exit` in the pipeline job.

jen: Awesome. Can you drop a short blurb in #eng-runtime changelog so ops knows pipelines will start failing on bad configs?

maria: Will do. Thanks! :thumbsup:
